seo.title: Edit PDF — Add Text, Images & Annotations | JPdf
seo.description: Add text, images, highlights, shapes, and freehand markup directly onto a PDF in your browser, then export a new file. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: Add text, images, highlights, and shapes on top of your PDF's pages.

howItWorks.title: How to edit a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF you want to mark up.
Pick a tool and click or drag on the page to add text, images, highlights, shapes, or freehand drawing.
Click Export to download a new PDF with your additions.

editor.overlayNote: Additions are drawn as new content on top of the page — this tool doesn't rewrite or reflow a PDF's existing text.

items.q: Can this edit the existing text already in my PDF?
items.a: No. PDF files don't store text the way a word processor does, so directly rewriting existing text reliably isn't possible here — this tool lets you add new text, images, highlights, and shapes on top of the page instead, which covers most real editing needs like adding notes, labels, or corrections.

items.q: What can I add to a page?
items.a: Text boxes, images (PNG or JPG), highlighter boxes, rectangles, and freehand drawing — each is added as real, permanent content in the exported PDF, not just a preview overlay.
Yes — use the undo/redo buttons or Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z while editing, any time before you export.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Your file is uploaded securely as soon as you select it, so it's ready to process; the changes you draw stay in your browser until you click Export, and are then applied on our servers. Uploaded files and results are automatically deleted after a short retention period.
